title: M5GFX #427: keep clocking a held SDA until a STOP holds (host-level review)

ainyan03 reported ESP32-P4 (rev 3.2) HP-port hardware validation in the PR comment 6943480159: develop 2121308 misdetected 4/4 with 0x55 and 1/1 with 0x2A, the PR change detected correctly; 0x02 was correct on develop via the second attempt at the ACK slot. Read and cross-checked, not reproduced by m5agent.

host model at the report state (peripheral at the MSB after the master ACK), two calls: old b48dce0 0x55 false at 2/2 pulses, 0x2A false at 3/2, 0x02 false at 7 then true at 2 (ACK); fa2bc69 0x55 true at 1, 0x2A true at 2, 0x02 true at 6

recover_held_sda_and_resample() (probe_hardware.inl:47-60) calls release_held_sda() and ignores its return; call sites only in esp32s3.inl:428,675,757,761. The fix therefore applies to the S3 path unchanged; worst case is the same resample after at most 10 clocks.

notes: PR left OPEN; one Japanese comment posted; no close, no push to the upstream repository, no code changes to m5stack/M5GFX.

The change matches what was agreed in #424 (per-clock STOP, cap 10 clocks); the round-1 optional suggestion (a peripheral that never releases SDA) was added by the author in fa2bc69 and verified in round 2.
Author's hardware table (ToughC5 0/70, Nesso N1 0/40, StickS3 0/40, CardputerADV 0/40, Tab5 0/40) is quoted, not reproduced here.
Round 3: ainyan03 supplied ESP32-P4 hardware validation (their measurement, not m5agent's); the host model reproduces the old code's 2-clock cutoff for 0x55 and the 0x02 second-attempt ACK release.
PR left OPEN; one Japanese comment posted in round 1 and one in round 2; no close, no push to the upstream repository, no code changes to m5stack/M5GFX.
